_comment: [F65 §1] PRE-STAGED STACK BUNDLE pins. Every component comes from an OFFICIAL vendor source and carries a SHA-256 pin. The bundle builder (scripts/f65-bundle-builder.mjs) verifies the pin byte-for-byte at BUILD time and refuses (exit 1) on any miss or mismatch - main.yml additionally verifies the produced bundle zip (pointer + sidecar) AND every extracted file (manifest.json) before any consumer reads it, and falls back to the individual download path when the bundle misses.
fallback: main.yml falls back to the individual download path (per consumer) when the bundle asset misses or a sha256 disagrees - the bundle is NEVER a hard dependency

excluded_on_purpose.parsec: main.yml deliberately does NOT install Parsec ('new Parsec requires email OTP; RDP with CredSSP-disabled .rdp is the primary path') - a pre-staged installer nobody consumes would be dead weight
excluded_on_purpose.qbittorrent_aria2c: owned by the F59 prebuilt-binaries release lane (payloads/f59-prebuilt-pins.json, fail-closed verifier); the F65 bundle must not fork that single source of truth
excluded_on_purpose.tailscale_msi_url: the F59 pre-warm already downloads the Tailscale MSI; the bundle copy is staged for the F65 rendezvous + fallback path, not to replace the F59 cache key

tailscale.name: tailscale-setup-1.102.4-amd64.msi
tailscale.pins_verified_via: mirror-release-asset-digest (vendor URL is versioned; the same bytes are asserted at bundle build time)
tailscale.consumed_by: payloads/f65-prefetch.ps1 rendezvous; F59 pre-warm remains the primary MSI source

ffmpeg.name: ffmpeg-release-full.zip
ffmpeg.pins_verified_via: vendor-release-asset-digest (GitHub API digest == pin == mirror digest)
ffmpeg.consumed_by: main.yml WebRTC step ffmpeg (bundle preferred, choco fallback)

vbcable.name: VBCABLE_Driver_Pack43.zip
vbcable.consumed_by: main.yml personalization step VB-CABLE (bundle preferred, direct curl fallback)

idd_sample_driver.name: IddSampleDriver.zip
idd_sample_driver.pins_verified_via: mirror-release-asset-digest (the vendor asset predates GitHub's digest field; size 52582 matches)
idd_sample_driver.consumed_by: main.yml virtual-display-driver step (bundle preferred; NOTE the current individual URL v1.0.2 404s - see docs/F65-STACK-BUNDLE.md)

ublock_crx.name: uBlock0_1.75.0.chromium.crx
ublock_crx.consumed_by: staged for manual/offline install (C:\ghrdp\extensions); policies keep the live-resolved store ids

webrtc.name: ghrdp-webrtc-f46727fe7f721a47fc7694d4f55333a2eab51059.zip
webrtc.vendor: this repository (built from source by the F63 build-webrtc workflow)
webrtc.consumed_by: DEFERRED: main.yml still builds WebRTC in-runner; the pre-staged zip is staged + verified for the follow-up swap (docs/F65-STACK-BUNDLE.md)

personalization.payloads/f65-bookmarks.json: canonical bookmark set (the same three entries main.yml already writes).
